newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SPADEL SELLS TROUBLED PORTUGUESE UNIT.
newsitem.headline: SPADEL SELLS TROUBLED PORTUGUESE UNIT.

text.p: Belgian mineral water group Spadel said on Tuesday it would sell its Portuguese unit Empresa das Aguas Do Alardo.

"The Spadel group announces that an opportunity arose to sell Empresa das Aguas do Alardo against conditions which ensure the continuity of the activity and for good dismiss Spadel of its obligations vis-a-vis Alardo," it said in a statement.
No further details of the transaction were provided.
Spadel said last week that Alardo had decided to file for bankruptcy.

Alardo was shut down on March 10 by Portuguese authorities after bottles of its water were found to contain traces of algae. Production and sales restarted March 20 after further tests revealed the water was safe for consumption.
Spadel had said earlier this month that efforts to sell Alardo had been fruitless.
